title: Synthesis — synth-weekday-est (zebra)
description: The kiosk's default board (design source: final-synth-7-zebra.html, plus three header treatments picked from synth7-zebra-variations.html). Destinations go mono; rows zebra-stripe edge-to-edge with a bolded/amber-accented lead row; state text ladders by weight, not color; the right header label is pluralized; the green 'estimado' pill is the sole live-data marker (no scheduled-time prefix); a small clock glyph fronts plain (non-estimated) countdown minutes. The header carries three chosen typographic treatments: a light proportional clock (clock-proportional-light) with faint trailing seconds, a single-line uppercase mono tracked date (date-uppercase-tracked), and an uppercase wide-tracked stop name (stopname-tracked-caps). Shipped as the unconditional default — the former `?board=synth7-zebra` toggle and useBoardVariant.ts have been removed.
warning: Ground-truth diff of the shipped default board, not a re-derivation of the standalone tags. (1) No longer gated: useBoardVariant.ts was deleted and every rule below applies unconditionally — the `?board=` query param is gone. (2) Header treatments were swapped from the original synthesis (clock-mono-tabular → clock-proportional-light; date-weekday-emphasis two-line stack → date-uppercase-tracked single line; the neutral stop name → stopname-tracked-caps) per the user's picks from synth7-zebra-variations.html. (3) Values adapted to the app's token/clamp system rather than the micro-tags' literal mockup sizes (e.g. row-zebra's fixed padding → the `--board-card-pad` clamp token; lead accent is a 4px border with padding-left compensation; state-weight-ladder is font-weight-only). All differentiation stays within existing hues (amber=attention/lead accent, green=live via the untouched .arrival-row__badge--estimated pill; no new colors). (4) The 🕐 schedule glyph on plain countdown rows is net-new and not backed by any standalone micro-variation tag.
